name: discussion-downloader
readme_summary: Discussion Downloader is a Chrome extension that allows users to save entire conversations from claude.ai into a Markdown file with a single click. It preserves the original formatting, including code blocks, lists, and tables, and adds a YAML header with metadata for easy organization.
key_features: Saves entire conversations from claude.ai to Markdown
Preserves original formatting (code blocks, lists, tables)
Includes YAML header with metadata (title, source, model, dates, message count)
Generates a clean, understandable filename
Requires minimal browser permissions (activeTab, scripting)
No external dependencies or build processes
primary_use_case: To easily export and archive Claude AI conversations in a structured Markdown format for personal notes, documentation, or further analysis.
cover_image_prompt: A digital librarian character meticulously organizing glowing scrolls of conversation. Each scroll is unfurling to reveal text, code snippets, and structured lists. The librarian is placing these scrolls into a large, open book labeled 'Claude Archive,' with a clean, organized layout. Subtle digital particles flow from the scrolls to the book, representing the data transfer. The background is a softly lit, modern study with a small, unobtrusive monitor displaying the repository's name, 'Discussion Downloader,' and a simplified icon of a download arrow. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, bright color palette and clear, readable elements.

name: nullframe
description: PROJECT NULLFRAME — a live telemetry dashboard in the Nothing design language
readme_summary: Project Nullframe is a live telemetry dashboard designed with the Nothing design language. It displays real-time browser performance metrics like frame rate, memory usage, battery status, and network information using a distinctive dot-matrix aesthetic and industrial instrument panel style.
key_features: Live telemetry dashboard
Nothing design language aesthetic (dot-matrix numerals, glyph-grid icon reel)
Ten bento widgets displaying real-time browser signals (frame rate, JS heap, battery, network, input)
Fallback to simulated data (SIM) for unsupported browsers
Single requestAnimationFrame loop for performance optimization
React 19, Vite, TypeScript stack
Command palette (⌘K) for focus mode, clock reroll, motion toggle
Optional zero-dependency Web Audio synth for hover tones
primary_use_case: To provide developers and designers with a visually engaging and performant real-time dashboard of browser performance metrics, styled according to the Nothing design language.
cover_image_prompt: A vintage, yet futuristic, industrial instrument panel from a design engineer's workstation in New York. The panel is filled with glowing dot-matrix displays showing real-time data streams: a rapidly ticking clock, a fluctuating frame rate graph, a pulsing memory usage bar, and a subtle network signal indicator. Small, stylized glyph icons animate on a grid. The overall aesthetic is clean, sharp, and minimalist, with a focus on functional beauty and the distinctive 'Nothing' design language. Subtle digital particles flow between the displays, hinting at the underlying code and data. The repository name 'NULLFRAME' is subtly etched into the metal casing. 3D isometric illustration, sharp focus, cool color palette with a single accent of brand red.

name: dnsglobe
description: Global DNS propagation checker TUI — watch a DNS record propagate across 34 public resolvers worldwide, on a world map in your terminal
readme_summary: dnsglobe is a terminal-based TUI application written in Rust that checks DNS record propagation across 34 global public DNS resolvers. It visualizes the results on a world map within the terminal, allowing users to monitor DNS changes in real-time.
key_features: Global DNS propagation checking across 34 resolvers
Terminal User Interface (TUI) with world map visualization
Real-time monitoring with watch mode
Direct querying of resolvers with EDNS0 and TCP fallback
Grouping of identical answers for round-robin DNS
Detailed resolver information (IP, RTT, TTL, expiry)
Dynamic map/globe view adapting to terminal width
Resolver site identification via NSID and other methods
primary_use_case: Monitoring and visualizing DNS record propagation across a wide range of global DNS resolvers directly from the terminal.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized world map displayed on a glowing terminal screen, with numerous colored dots representing DNS resolvers worldwide. A central, pulsating data stream flows from a domain name (represented by a small, abstract icon) towards these dots. Some dots glow green, indicating successful propagation, while others show different colors representing varying statuses like 'in flight' or 'differs'. Subtle digital particles and lines connect the domain icon to the resolvers, illustrating the global check. The overall mood is informative and slightly futuristic, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The repository name 'dnsglobe' is subtly integrated into the terminal's interface. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear data visualization.

name: Infographic
description: 🦋 An Infographic Generation and Rendering Framework, bring words to life with AI!
readme_summary: AntV Infographic is a declarative infographic visualization engine that uses AI to generate and render high-quality infographics. It offers a rich set of features including AI-friendly configuration, numerous templates, a theme system, and a built-in editor, all while outputting high-quality SVG.
key_features: AI-friendly configuration and syntax for AI generation
Support for AI streaming output and rendering
Approximately 200 built-in infographic templates, components, and layouts
Theme system with preset themes and deep customization
Built-in editor for AI-generated infographics
High-quality SVG output for visual fidelity and editing
primary_use_case: Generating and rendering infographics, making information presentation more efficient and data storytelling simpler, with AI assistance.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical AI robot artist holding a paintbrush, standing before a blank canvas. With a gesture, it transforms a stream of simple text prompts and raw data flowing from a tablet into a vibrant, complex infographic filled with charts, icons, and flowing arrows. The infographic glows with digital energy. Subtle elements like lines of code and data points are visible in the background. The scene is set in a bright, modern studio with a clean, focused composition. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a colorful and engaging aesthetic, emphasizing the transformation of words and data into visual stories.
